content.comment_body: Hi, I'm fairly new to [product_name] but have completed a few projects before. This is my first time working with analog functions and I'm facing an issue. I have set up an analog input and scaling for a 4-20 mA pressure transducer, and everything appears to work correctly in the builtin simulator. However, after downloading the program to [product_name], I encountered an error indicating the output of the min/max block isn't connected. I'm unsure what the min/max block output should connect to. My goal is to enable a text block to display the max pressure on my [product_name] panel, so I can monitor the highest pressure reached by the hydraulic circuit. [product_name] [article_no] [product_name] panel LCS [version_no] Thank you for any help in advance.

Every block with an output, whether digital or analog, must be connected to something else. This means the block output needs to be linked elsewhere, except for cases involving digital or analog outputs or flags. You can achieve this by connecting the block output to the input of another block, to a marker or output block, or by wiring a digital block output to an open terminal.
However, you may have additional issues in your project. What is the actual range of your sensor? Is it between 0 and 6.25 bar?

In [product_name] Soft Comfort, pressing F2 will bring up information about unconnected blocks and other details. In your program, you can remove Block B005 and simply adjust B001 to match your sensor. What's the range of your sensor?
He understands the issue but doesn't know the specific solution yet.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants encountered challenges connecting analog min/max values for visualization on an operator panel using [product_name] and [product_name] Soft Comfort. The main problem was an error triggered by an unconnected block output, which led to confusion about how to set up proper connections for analog values. Feedback suggested that [product_name] Soft Comfort provides error notifications and useful features, like pressing F2 to get block connection status, but newer users may find these features difficult to interpret. Additional complexity arose from configuring correct sensor ranges and choosing the right blocks.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a simple, error-free method to connect and display the maximum analog value from a process sensor on the operator panel using [product_name] and [product_name] Soft Comfort.
